method: Stage-by-stage comparison of the measured reference against the assembled result; luminance sampled at each stage midpoint from a 4 fps extraction.
whatIsNotCompared: literal room geometry - this house's kitchen is not the reference's kitchen and is not meant to match it
surface colours and materials - driven by this house's own palette
correlationCaveat: allStageLuminanceCorrelation is expected to be weak and is reported only for completeness: most of the reference's early luminance movement is content entering frame (dark joinery), not a lighting change, and two different kitchens cannot agree on that. lightingArcCorrelation covers the stages where lighting is the only variable.

stages.gesture: open-hand sweep along the ceiling/wall junction, fingers spread, entering from the top of frame
pinch at the right edge of the new cabinet block, dragging right to extend the run
horizontal sweep left-to-right beneath the upper cabinets
two-sided placement - hand indicates each flank in turn
repeated small pinches along the worktop
pinch at the ceiling, drawing a horizontal element downward into place
two-finger placement in the foreground, then drag right to extend the mass
successive pinch-placements along the island face, one per seat
final delicate pinch-placements at worktop and island centre, then hands exit frame

note: The side-by-side sheet including reference frames is generated locally into .transformation-work/qa/ and is deliberately not committed; only our own frames are published.
